description.html: The anchor with corals is a decorative element that gives an aquarium a marine theme. The dark, weathered anchor with a chain stands on a base with purple and pink corals, creating the impression of a ship's anchor that has lain on the seabed for years and been reclaimed by nature. The contrast between the dark anchor and the vivid corals adds visual depth to the aquarium.

The anchor is an upright ornament, so it nicely fills the space between low decorations and plants. It is ideal for a nautical theme combined with the pirate ship, shipwrecks and the pirate skull. The corals on the base can serve as a visual accent in aquariums where live plants are not an option, for example with fish that uproot or eat plants.

Before placing it, rinse the anchor in lukewarm water, without soap or detergents. Set it on a flat surface and press the base lightly into the sand or gravel so it does not tip over when fish swim around it. It is easy to clean by rinsing under running water and using a soft brush during regular maintenance. Find more ornaments among our supplies.
